# Roadmap — save-your-skin

Live milestones in `after` order, then standing tracks. Acceptance verdicts are computed
from evidence under the descendant-commit rule (D-016).

## Milestones

### M1 — walking skeleton

`completed` · `@sys.milestone.m1-walking-skeleton/1` · target 2026-03-31

The viewer and the simulator both boot, the viewer draws one frame from
simulator state, and no engine type appears in a viewer signature.

**Acceptance** — 1 of 1 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `viewer-boundary-clean` | command | **satisfied** by `@lege.evidence.boundary-lint-pass/1` (pass at `b2e58f14`, descends from `3f0a1c9d`) |

**Work items** — _(none)_

### M2 — deterministic simulator

`completed` · `@sys.milestone.m2-deterministic-sim/1` · target 2026-06-30 · after `@sys.milestone.m1-walking-skeleton/1`

The simulator is reproducible from a seed across the supported platforms, and
the determinism suite runs in CI on every commit.

**Acceptance** — 1 of 1 satisfied

| Check | Method | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `determinism-suite-green` | command | **satisfied** by `@sim.evidence.determinism-suite-pass/1` (pass at `5d9c2a70`, descends from `7c41d0ba`) |

**Depends on** [The simulator is reproducible from a seed](CURRENT-STATE.md#the-simulator-is-reproducible-from-a-seed) `@sys.req.deterministic-sim/1`

**Work items** — _(none)_

### M3 — playable day

`active` · `@sys.milestone.m3-playable-day/1` · target 2026-09-30 · after `@sys.milestone.m2-deterministic-sim/1`

soft-lock, or a placeholder asset.

## Tracks

Standing work that no milestone contains.

### Lighting

`active` · `@sys.track.lighting/1` · scope `path "content/**/light/**"`, `path "lege/src/light/**"` · cadence "one pass per milestone"

Standing lighting work that no milestone contains: one pass per milestone,
plus fixes as scenes land. Lighting is the one track where the simulator is
permitted to lag the engine.

**Work items** — _(none)_

Carried into this track by disposition: `@sys.work.m3-lighting-pass/1`.

### Performance watch

`active` · `@sys.track.perf-watch/1` · scope `path "lege/**"`, `path "sim/**"` · cadence "once per milestone, plus on demand"

Keep the frame budget honest across milestones: measure p99 frame time on the
target hardware at the end of every milestone and record the result as
evidence.

**Depends on** [16 ms frame budget](CURRENT-STATE.md#16-ms-frame-budget) `@sys.constraint.frame-budget-16ms/1`

**Work items** — _(none)_

### Tooling hygiene

`active` · `@sys.track.tooling-hygiene/1` · scope `path "docs/generated/**"`, `path "tools/**"` · cadence "continuous"

Keep the build and the generated views honest: no hand edits, no stale views
in a commit, and no lint that everyone has learned to ignore.

**Depends on** [Generated views are never edited by hand](CURRENT-STATE.md#generated-views-are-never-edited-by-hand) `@sys.policy.no-hand-edited-views/1`

**Work items**

- `proposed` [Import the legacy roadmap](ACTIVE-WORK.md#import-the-legacy-roadmap) `@sys.work.legacy-roadmap-import/1`
